cases.version: historical: before opt-in F32 GELU correction

limitations: Functional validation and model conversions overlapped some timings; these are observed baselines, not isolated benchmark claims.
Probe timings exclude Engine/source construction. First Rust calls fault mmap pages and upload device weights; PyTorch weights are loaded before its timer.
Warm probes retain loaded Weight/GPU wrappers; production decide rebuilds borrowed trunk wrappers and may upload again. Public entrypoint timings are in canonical entry-validation/*/commands.json.
GPU is a mixed graph: projections/verified attention on device; gated-delta scan, norms and small projections on CPU; shared attention may verify/fall back.
Q8_0 vision made 26084 submissions on the image sample and was slower than CPU, indicating shared vision dispatch/transfer overhead.
Q8_0 fixed logit gates currently fail; these performance measurements do not establish numerical acceptance.
